title: Counting Windows for Approved Claim Days — Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
**The window over which approved claim days are counted**

The long service term is 24 months. The wide claim window is 12 months and the medium claim window is 6 months, each of them taken up to the day the credit is worked out.

Where the cafe has been serving for more than the long service term and a resumption request stands approved on the contract, the claim days counted are those approved over the wide claim window up to the day the credit is worked out. Where the cafe has been serving for more than the long service term and no resumption request stands approved on the contract, the claim days counted are those approved over the medium claim window up to the day the credit is worked out. Where the cafe has been serving for the long service term or less, the claim days counted are those approved over the standard claim window up to the day the credit is worked out.

| Months the cafe has been serving | Resumption request standing on the contract | Claim days counted |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than 24 | one or more standing approved | those approved over the wide claim window, being the 12 months up to the day the credit is worked out |
| more than 24 | none standing approved | those approved over the medium claim window, being the 6 months up to the day the credit is worked out |
| 24 or fewer | not read | those approved over the standard claim window up to the day the credit is worked out |

**How each condition is read on the records**

The months the cafe has been serving are the months of service standing on the workplace cafe management contract held under the Workplace Cafe Management Program, taken up to the day the credit is worked out; a site serving for exactly 24 months has not been serving for more than the long service term. A resumption request is read from the contract's service request log, and it is read only where it stands approved; how many such requests stand approved beyond the first makes no difference, since the two long service readings turn on whether any stands approved at all.

**Hypothetical records on either side of the term**

A site that has hypothetically been serving for 24 months on the day the credit is worked out has its approved claim days counted over the standard claim window, whatever resumption requests stand on its contract. A site that has hypothetically been serving for 25 months with one approved resumption request has them counted over the wide claim window, being the 12 months up to that day; the same site with no approved resumption request standing has them counted over the medium claim window, being the 6 months up to that day.
